description: This file defines the MyNotesDashlet class, which extends the DashletGeneric class to implement a custom dashboard widget for displaying notes associated with the current user in a SuiteCRM environment. It includes constructor logic for setting up the dashlet's title, search fields, columns, and seed bean.

classes.name: MyNotesDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget class for displaying user-specific notes in SuiteCRM, extending DashletGeneric.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dashlet with title, search fields, columns, and seed bean based on provided parameters and external data.
